title: Co-Accused Acquitted On Same Evidence: Madras High Court Discharges UK Resident In CBI Illegal Telephone Exchange Case
description: The Madras High Court has discharged a U K-based accused from a CBI prosecution relating to an alleged illegal telephone exchange, holding that the evidence against him was inseparable from that against the co-accused, who had already been acquitted in the main trial. The Court observed that compelling the petitioner to face trial on the very same evidence would amount to an abuse of the process of law. Justice M. Nirmal Kumar allowed the criminal revision petition filed by Shri Harsha Srinivas
